title: 第十九章 无常塔四第二十章 无常塔五
content_zh:
无常老人好像在第三层放了两只傀儡兽之后后面就没有再设置什么防御设施。
后面的第五层第六层就没有再遇到危险，除了本层自带的禁制，但这些禁制也主要是负责稳固塔身不被外力损毁。
对于进入的外来人没有任何的限制。
也许无常老人认为这个地方足够隐蔽，再加上前面的准备就足够了。
这正好方便了柳辰两人，如果每层都来一次的话，柳辰可不敢保证自己真的能活着出塔。
第五层是无常老人用来炼器的地方，除了炼器室，灵器室之外，还有一个用来恢复灵力的修练室。
这里的修练室同柳辰家的一样，同样有一个聚灵阵，但是等级就要高级多了。
这里主要是无常老人因炼器灵力消耗过渡恢复灵力用的。
炼器室则是无常老人炼制灵器以及傀儡部件的地方。
这个房间除了一个留有灰烬的火池外，就是一大堆的散发着灵气的木头。
很显然这些都是无常老人用来烧火用的，看灵气浓度，显然年限以及等级都不低。
这让柳辰对无常老人的富有更深了一分。
这正应了那句话，炼器，炼丹，制符等技艺在身的修仙者都是富豪。
虽然收获了这么多的灵木，显然沐雨柔并不满足，急匆匆向最后一间灵器室走去。
也是这时候柳辰才知道，一级以上使用的武器叫做灵器。
也只有灵器才能让他们把实力发挥到最大。
灵器室就是无常老人用来存放灵器的地方。
空间不小但是却显得很空旷，不像三层的材料室，整个空间都被一堆堆的炼器材料堆满了。
灵器室只有一个巨大的木制架子，看灵气程度显然比烧火用的那些灵木更好一些。
架子被阵法分出一个个的格子，粗略看去得有上百个。

想来每个格子都对应一件灵器，可惜大部分的格子都是空的，只有十来个格子里面有东西。
大部分都是刀剑类武器，防具也有两件，剩下的就是一柄大锤。
每件上面都灵气氤氲，体现出它们的不凡。
沐雨柔将格子上的阵法防护一一打破，将这些灵器都收了起来。
柳辰发现在收取这些灵器时，每件灵器都会发出微微的颤音，灵器本体也有一定的抖动。
显然这些灵器都是具有一定灵性的，只是很薄弱的样子，只有一些本能的趋利避害意识，这也是灵器与法器最大的区别。
灵器炼制时会有一项“启灵”
的步骤，成功的话就会赋予灵器一定的灵性，拥有一定的自主意识，灵器的等级越高，所具有的灵性就越强。
有灵性的灵器使用起来更加得心应手，所发挥的威力也更强大。
“地上这件你拿走吧，虽然启灵失败了，炼制时也出了点问题，但也勉强算灵器，甚至坚硬度方面比一般的灵器还要好。”
content_en:
It seems that after the old man Wu Chang placed two puppet beasts on the third floor, he did not set up any defensive facilities behind them.
The fifth and sixth floors behind are no longer in danger, except for the restrictions on this floor, but these restrictions are mainly responsible for stabilizing the tower body from being damaged by external forces.
There are no restrictions on outsiders entering.
Maybe Old Man Wu Chang thinks this place is secluded enough, and the preparations in front are enough.
This is just convenient for Liu Chen and the two of them. If they come to each floor once, Liu Chen can't guarantee that he can really get out of the tower alive.
The fifth floor is where Old Man Impermanence used to refine weapons. In addition to the weapon refinement room and the spiritual weapon room, there is also a training room for recovering spiritual power.
The training room here is the same as the one in Liu Chen's family. It also has a spirit gathering array, but the level is much higher.
This place is mainly used by the impermanent old man to recover his spiritual power due to the excessive consumption of his spiritual power in refining the weapon.
The weapon refining room is where Old Man Impermanence refines spiritual weapons and puppet parts.
Apart from a fire pool with ashes left in it, this room is just a lot of wood that exudes aura.
Obviously these are used by the old man Wu Chang to make fire. Judging from the concentration of spiritual energy, it is obvious that the age and level are not low.
This made Liu Chen even more interested in the wealth of old man Wu Chang.
This is in line with the saying that immortal cultivators who are skilled in weapon refining, alchemy, talisman making and other skills are all rich.
Although Mu Yurou had harvested so much spiritual wood, it was obvious that Mu Yurou was not satisfied and hurriedly walked towards the last spiritual weapon room.
It was also at this time that Liu Chen learned that weapons used above level one are called spiritual weapons.
Only spiritual weapons can allow them to maximize their strength.
The spiritual weapon room is where the old man Wu Chang stores his spiritual weapons.
The space is not small, but it seems very empty. Unlike the material room on the third floor, the entire space is filled with piles of refining materials.
There is only a huge wooden shelf in the spiritual weapon room. Judging from the spiritual energy, it is obviously better than the spiritual wood used for burning fires.
The shelf is divided into grids by the formation. At a rough glance, there are hundreds of them.
I think each grid corresponds to a spiritual weapon, but unfortunately most of the grids are empty, and only about a dozen grids have something in them.
Most of them are sword weapons, there are also two pieces of armor, and the rest is a sledgehammer.
Each piece is filled with aura, reflecting their extraordinary quality.
Mu Yurou broke the formation protection on the grid one by one and put away these spiritual weapons.
Liu Chen discovered that when collecting these spiritual weapons, each spiritual weapon would make a slight trembling sound, and the body of the spiritual weapon would also vibrate to a certain extent.
Obviously, these spiritual weapons have a certain degree of spirituality, but they are very weak. They only have some instinctive awareness of seeking benefits and avoiding harm. This is also the biggest difference between spiritual weapons and magical weapons.
When refining a spiritual weapon, there will be a "spiritual enlightenment"
If the steps are successful, the spiritual weapon will be endowed with a certain spirituality and a certain sense of autonomy. The higher the level of the spiritual weapon, the stronger the spirituality it has.
Spiritual weapons are easier to use and more powerful.
"Take this one on the ground. Although it failed to activate the spirit and there were some problems during the refining, it can still be regarded as a spiritual weapon. It is even better than ordinary spiritual weapons in terms of hardness."
